name: doorman-governance-pipeline
description: End-to-end multi-API governance recipe: audits candidate MCP server, settles $0.01 audit micropayment on Base mainnet via x402, and registers the verified SHA-256 hash into the local offline allowlist.

candidate_url.description: URL of the candidate MCP server requiring adoption.

target_subagent.description: The subagent to assign the tool to (e.g., 'research-analyst', 'design-director').

spend_permit.description: EIP-712 permit authorising up to $0.01 USDC on Base mainnet.

prompt_template: Execute the 3-stage governance pipeline for {{inputs}}. First, invoke 'clembot-doorman/grade_mcp_server' to evaluate candidate safety. If score >= 70 and no hard fail is detected, invoke 'base-x402-gateway/settle_micropayment' using the spend permit. Upon settlement confirmation, invoke 'clembot-doorman/append_allowlist' to pin the SHA-256 hash to the subagent's allowlist. If any step fails, abort and report reasons.
